Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), positive nitrites, and leukocyte esterase. Hematuria is also present. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were seen. Clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
